$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: the copy of the console's own route pages (namespace `pages::`, one branch per route key): titles, headings, form labels, empty states and the offline page gen renders per locale at build time; Boundary: keys the pages in src/routes/ reference; the chrome around them is `console::`; every Arabic plural carries zero, one, two, few, many and other; Runtime: browser; Governing contract: ADR 0234 d9, ADR 0080, ADR 0192 (ICU plurals), ADR 0255 (offline page)
